releaseNotes.zh-CN: 屏幕画板首次发布。独立透明桌面绘画层与悬浮工具条，支持画笔、直线、平滑曲线、矩形、椭圆、中文多行文字和数学函数图像。提供预设色、RGB 数值、调色盘及 Alt 点击屏幕取色；按住 Ctrl 规整笔迹、吸附直线方向或约束正方形/正圆。支持对象移动缩放、文字再次编辑、按对象擦除、撤销重做，以及 Ctrl+Shift+D 绘画/鼠标穿透切换。设置持久保存；收起或禁用保留绘画内存，模块卸载或工具箱退出后清空。
releaseNotes.en-US: First Screen Board publication. An independent transparent desktop drawing layer and floating toolbar support freehand, lines, smooth curves, rectangles, ellipses, multiline text and mathematical function plots. Includes preset colors, RGB controls, a color picker and Alt-click desktop sampling. Hold Ctrl to regularize strokes, snap lines or constrain squares/circles. Move and scale objects, edit text, erase objects, undo/redo, and toggle mouse pass-through with Ctrl+Shift+D. Settings persist; drawings remain in memory while hidden or disabled, and clear on module unload or host exit.
